summary.result: As a result, it was judged effective in terms of water supply managing the lower storage rate up to 30% when the initial storage rate of farming period is above annual average for the Naju reservoir considering existing water management practice.
summary.background: While the main purpose of irrigation reservoirs is to supply agricultural water, the needs of environmental flow and flood control has been expanded.
